cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before I tell you who won, which candidate were you hoping for? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Ignore my face. It isn't your ballot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'd never know whether your kindness voted with me.

mechanism: A negotiates a private written candidate preference before revealing A choice or election result, giving B control of when the matched papers open.
confusable: Unlike mutual disclosure first, A insists B commit their true preference before learning A stake.
comparison: Private names and a result envelope differ from naming job-offer wishes before A decision.
seedUse: D208-a disappointment and choice-first demand; S02-a uses a fairer-seeming written sequence to retain cooperation.
